court: In the High Court of Madras
judgment_text:
This Civil Revision Petition has been filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India seeking to direct the learned principal Sub Judge, Ponneri, for speedy disposal of OS No. 141 of 2022 within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This Civil Revision Petition (CRP) has been filed seeking for a limited relief. The petitioners seek for early disposal of the suit in O.S. No. 141 of 2022, pending on the file of principal sub-court, Ponneri.

2. In the suit, the petitioners are the plaintiffs and the respondent is the defendant. The suit has been filed for declaration and for recovery of possession. According to the petitioners, eventhough a written statement was filed by the respondent as early as in the year 2025, till date, issues have not been framed by the trial court. The petitioners seek for early disposal of the suit.

3. No prejudice will be caused to any of the parties if a direction is issued to the principal sub-court, Ponneri, to dispose of the aforesaid suit within a time frame to be fixed by this Court. This Court, after giving due consideration to the year of the suit as well as the present stage of the suit, directs the principal sub-court, Ponneri, to dispose of the suit in O.S. No. 141 of 2022, after framing issues, within a period of one year from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. With this direction, this Civil Revision Petition is disposed of. No Costs. Since no adverse orders are passed against the respondent, notice to the respondent in this CRP is dispensed with.
